title: Accuracy of a Covered Trace Estimate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0<\\tau\\le1$, and let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs. Suppose every record in a finite trace has estimate within strictly less than $\\tau^2/4$ of its corresponding restricted Fourier weight. Let $J$ be a set of coordinates, let $F$ be a finite family of coordinate subsets covered by the trace (each $U\\in F$ has a record with coordinate set $J$ and frequency prefix $U$), and take $U\\in F$ with $U\\subseteq J$. The trace estimate at $J$ and the free part of $U$ differs from the restricted Fourier weight of $f$ at that same coordinate set and free part by strictly less than $\\tau^2/4$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs
every record in the trace is accurate within strictly less than $\\tau^2/4$
the trace covers every frequency subset in $F$ at coordinate set $J$
